div.head: V Atr 12
div.ab: ⁊ saulsceat is rihtast, þæt man symle gelæste æt openum græfe.
⁊ saulsceat is rihtas, þæt man symle gelæste á æt openum græfe.
⁊ sawlsceat is rihtast, þæt man symle gelæste æt openum græfe.
⁊ sawlsceat is rihtast þæt man symle gelæste æt openum græfe.
And saulsceat is rihtast þæt man symle gelæste æt openum græfe.
Und Seelengeld ist am richtigsten, dass man immer [sofort] zahle bei offenem Grabe.
And as for soul-scot, it is most right that it always be paid [at once] at the open grave.
And it is best that payment for the souls of the dead should always be rendered before the grave is closed.
And it is best that payment for the soul be always paid at the open grave.
And it is most appropriate that dues for the souls of the dead always be paid while the grave is yet open.
